newsitem.title: USA: Asarco sells Grupo Mexico shares.
newsitem.headline: Asarco sells Grupo Mexico shares.

text.p: Asarco Inc said Thursday it had sold 20 million Series L shares of Grupo Mexico SA at 22 pesos per share for gross proceeds of about $54.9 million.
Asarco said the sale will result in an after-tax gain of about $4.1 million, or $0.09 per share, on a total gain of $6.2 million.
The private placement to institutional investors outside the United States was arranged by Credit Suisse First Boston.
Asarco said the sale leaves it with 84.2 million L shares, representing 12.2 percent of GMexico's outstanding shares. Asarco also holds B shares that bring its stake to 20.7 percent.
"Improved conditions in the copper market and for Mexican equities have allowed us to complete this sale of Grupo Mexico L shares on favorable terms," Asarco said.

"This is an important first step in our program of realizing value from our investment in Grupo Mexico. We will use the proceeds of this sale to further reduce debt and will also consider a share repurchase program."
